user.title: Set up Notify Switchboard
user.description: Notify Switchboard is a proxy: it does not deliver notifications itself. After setup, use the options to choose which notify services it forwards to.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Notify Switchboard is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Notify Switchboard targets
init.description: Choose the notify services that Notify Switchboard forwards messages to.

data_description.default_targets: Comma-separated notify service names, e.g. notify.mobile_app_amiel, notify.persistent_notification
